data.name: Neuter Master
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Neuter Master — a lighthearted roguelite-meets-casual game where breeding animals, matching them on a grid, and giving the occasional snip are all part of the fun!

The game progresses year by year, with each year divided into four distinct seasons:
Spring – Unlock new tiles, activate fresh grid matches, and get ready for the summer rush.
Summer – Send your animals into the field, let them mingle freely, and see what kind of offspring they produce!
Autumn – Collect gold from your lineup, trigger slot-machine-style match bonuses, and pick powerful roguelike rewards.
Winter – Manage your herd: feed them, sterilize “problem” animals, or… send them into permanent retirement.

Match animals on a customizable grid to earn gold. Three in a row? Jackpot! Spend your gold to buy new animals or tiles, and breed your way to legendary traits through inheritance and surprising mutations.

With over-the-top cartoon visuals, diverse animal traits, and endless breeding combinations, every year becomes a chaotic yet strategic experiment in genetics.

Are you ready to become the ultimate Neuter Master?
